title: Extremely Lifelike Fishing
intro: Sit in a pedal-drive kayak on the open sea and fish with your own two arms. Each arm has a shoulder and an elbow on its own keys, so casting takes practice.
no_webgl: This game draws with WebGL, and this browser does not offer the version it needs. A recent Chrome, Firefox or Safari does.
how.cast: Cast: hold F, swing the rod back with I, swing it forward with K, and let go of F as the rod passes upright.
how.sink: Let the lure sink while line runs out, then press Space to close the bail and wind.
how.work: Wind in bursts and pause. A fish that follows often takes the lure as it stops.
how.set: When a fish bites, sweep the rod up fast: that is the hook set.
how.fight: Keep the line tight. Wind when the fish rests; let the drag give line when it runs.
how.scope: Hold the right mouse button for the scope; the wheel zooms.
ring.label: Tension
arms.heading: Arms
hint.cast: Hold F, swing the rod back with I, then forward with K, and let go of F.
hint.running: Line is running out. Press Space to close the bail and wind.
hint.work: Wind in bursts with Space, then pause. Fish follow a lure that moves and stops.
hint.following: A {fish} is following. Keep the lure moving, then pause.
hint.fight: Fish on. Wind while it rests; the drag gives line when it runs.
event.bit: Bite. Set the hook: sweep the rod up now.
event.hook_set: Hooked a {fish}. Keep the line tight.
event.threw: The line went slack and the hook came loose.
event.jumped: It jumped. Keep the line tight.
event.snapped: The line snapped. A new lure is tied on.
landed.heading: Landed
settings.heading: Settings
settings.note: Slower arms and steady hands make casting easier. They never change how a fish behaves.
